title: Reese Leviathan
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A low-register Reese bass built from a detune-thickened supersaw core that roars and screams as a slow filter journey opens the ladder over 32 cycles. Detune width, drive and resonance all travel on prime-numbered clocks while jux-split echoes thicken the stereo field.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 <ab1 c2> [f1 eb1]>*4").s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(23).range(0.1, 0.6)).unison(7).spread(saw.slow(17).range(0.3, 0.9))
    .fm("<0 1 2 0>/8").fmh("<1 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 3200)).resonance(sine.slow(19).range(8, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(29).range(1, 4)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.2)
    .shape(saw.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.55)).distort("<0 0.3 0.5 0.2>/8")
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.7).release(0.08)
    .vib("<0 5 8>/16").vibmod(0.4)
    .jux(rev)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75).lpf(2400))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .room(0.18).delay("0.4:0.375:0.5")
    .gain(0.92)
)
